fichas.title: Building Excavations
fichas.summary: Guidance on investigating soil and groundwater conditions and designing building excavations. Basement excavation sides are generally battered; recommended maximum slope angles depend on soil type. Protective covering, slope banks, or structural support may be needed to prevent erosion or collapse. A working space is recommended between the excavation support or batter and the building foundation.
uses: Excavating for building foundations and basements
